- Half-state read, not written: `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` together; the second leaves in the ruling's stroke.

- `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` and `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts` carry the `externalId` regrade from #26598.
- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` carries the 2–3 letter locale subtag from #26770. None of this PR's 6 `disabledReason` lines in that file moved.

An action can now say why it is greyed: `disabledReason` sits beside `disabled` in `ActionSchema`. It is translatable (`i18n-extract` emits the key, the translation bundle carries the slot, and the reference validator checks it) and documented in `actions.mdx`. The liveness row stays `planned` with `authorWarn` until the console reads it.

Still open on this card: PR 2 (the console renders the reason, `Fixes #26619`) flips the liveness row to `live`, drops `authorWarn`/`authorHint`, and turns the lint block into a silence pin. The card stays `pm:dispatched` until PR 2 lands. The skills row is #26820.

Landed · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-27T20:36Z

PR #26869 (PR 2 of 2, the console half) merged at `eab4bbaf`, which is an ancestor of `origin/main`. All 28 paths the PR touched match the accepted head `4b5b87d2` byte for byte in the merge tree.

With both halves in, a greyed action says why it is greyed. `disabledReason` sits beside `disabled` on an action, as a string or an inline locale map, and is translatable at `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.disabledReason` / `globalActions.ACTION.disabledReason`.

The console shows it wherever an action is greyed: the record header and its overflow menu, record quick actions, the declared actions bar, and the four `action:*` renderers. A button carries it as a hover title and an accessible description. A menu item shows it as a second line. An action that declares no reason shows "Not available for this record".

The liveness row is `live`, and the planned-property warning is gone.

The card closed through `Fixes #26619`, and this seat removes `pm:dispatched`. The skills row is #26790. Along the way, #26859 restored the `actionKeys` inventory row that PR 1 left red on `main`.
